# 24clima

> Air conditioning (HVAC) service company in Panama City and Panamá Oeste. Installation, maintenance, deep cleaning, repair and refrigerant recharge, plus temporary AC rental for events. Available 24/7. Quotes and bookings go through WhatsApp: +507 6828-2120.

Site content is written in Spanish (default, no URL prefix). English and Russian translations of the same pages live under `/en/` and `/ru/`. Prices range from $29.99 for a single AC cleaning to $20,000 for a full concealed ducted system in an apartment. Founded 2024. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/24clima

## Services

- [AC deep cleaning](https://24clima.com/servicios/limpieza/): coil and filter cleaning, the entry-level service (from $29.99 per unit).
- [Maintenance](https://24clima.com/servicios/mantenimiento/): scheduled preventive maintenance for split and window units.
- [Repair](https://24clima.com/servicios/reparacion/): diagnosis and repair of units that fail to cool, leak or make noise.
- [Installation](https://24clima.com/servicios/instalacion/): installation of new split, multi-split and window units.
- [Refrigerant recharge](https://24clima.com/servicios/carga-de-gas/): gas top-up and leak detection.
- [24/7 emergency service](https://24clima.com/servicios/emergencia/): same-day and after-hours callouts.
- [Gypsum ceilings and walls](https://24clima.com/servicios/gypsum/): drywall ceilings and partitions ready to paint, LED coves, MR board for wet areas (from $35/m²).
- [Ducted air conditioning (concealed fan coil)](https://24clima.com/servicios/aire-acondicionado-por-ductos/): turnkey ducted system — fan coil, ducts, linear diffusers and the gypsum ceiling around it, one contractor (from $6,000).

## For businesses and property managers

- [Service for PH property administrators](https://24clima.com/servicio-para-administradoras-ph/): building-wide AC service for condominium administrators.
- [Maintenance contracts](https://24clima.com/contrato-mantenimiento-aire-acondicionado/): recurring maintenance agreements.
- [AC rental for events](https://24clima.com/alquiler-aire-acondicionado-eventos/): temporary cooling for tents, expos, conferences and weddings.

## Service area

Ciudad de Panamá: Costa del Este, Punta Pacífica, Albrook, Clayton, Panamá Pacífico, San Francisco, El Cangrejo, Obarrio, Bella Vista.
Panamá Oeste: Arraiján, Nuevo Arraiján, Vista Alegre, Costa Verde, La Chorrera, El Espino, La Floresta, Vacamonte, Playa Dorada Residences.
